description: Held-out SYNTHETIC validation data. 'vectors' are single events scored as sessions with no history (AneScorer::score); 'windows' are multi-event sessions (AneScorer::score_window), events oldest -> newest as sparse [feature index, value] lists. reference_fp32 is the PyTorch FP32 forward pass of the trained weights; coreml_* are CoreML FP16 predictions (coremltools). The last vectors are all-zeros, all-ones and the four PayPal bench orders.
